headline: As of 2026-10-24: 26,219,270 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 47 of 50 states, D+11.6 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 26,219,270 early/mail ballots cast so far across 47 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+11.6 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (3,638,904), California (2,758,100), Florida (2,443,926).
